decisions.reason: The file-format change does not alter the requirement to provide a complete drawing set.
The assembly model remains required; its delivery formats are owned by the source Requirement and do not change the candidate's model-delivery state.
Selecting PDF, DWG, STEP, and editable SolidWorks formats does not change the established color treatment of drawing views.
The source message's separate dimension decision is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the file-format change requires no annotation-state edit.
Requiring editable SolidWorks deliverables does not revoke the fact that the available client template is in Autodesk Inventor or change the ČSN/EN standards requirement.
Deliverable file formats do not affect the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The format decision does not change any part material or the requirement to show materials on drawings.
The bushing's fit, guidance, retention, and hole configuration remain unchanged by the deliverable-format decision.
The selected CAD and drawing formats do not alter the main-shaft geometry requirements.
The deliverable-format change does not alter the sliding mandrel's piston-end arrangement, holes, or required keyway groove.
The fabrication and machining sequence remains valid regardless of the required output file formats.
